142127: Yiyi Xu is a professor and a scientist at Alltale Management Facility and colleagues of Tsunehisa Senko and Katagaki Naomi. She is a serious and hardworking person and friendly towards her fellow workers.
142131: She is a silent person that usually looks unapproachable because she prefers to read and be alone instead of spending time with her classmates. She is very confident and serious about her decisions which is another reason she stands out most of the time.
142133: Katagaki Naomi is an ordinary high school student and especially doesn't have any social skills. He is usually seen reading novel books, but he gets to a point where he wanted some friends. His shy type of personality had eventually made him a loner.
